layout.hierarchy: Title is largest and darkest at top center. Main diagram is the dominant visual element in the center. Bottom annotation boxes are smaller supporting elements. Text inside diagram nodes is small.

visual_elements.description: Neural network diagram inside a beige rectangle. Left edge shows 3 purple dots feeding into a column of 3 white circles with red Σ. These connect via f(σ) boxes to a column of 3 white circles with blue Σ outlines (Previous Layer l). These connect via red weighted arrows labeled w_ji through Net_j and O_j boxes to a column of 3 green circles with Σ (Current Layer j). These connect via red weighted arrows labeled w_kj through Net_k and O_k boxes to a column of 3 orange circles with Σ (Next Layer k / Output layer). These connect via f(σ) boxes to output labels 'Output 1', 'Output 2', 'Output m'. Circled '1' labels appear near bottom of columns indicating node bias.
Light purple box 'Input Sample' top-left with dotted arrow pointing right into diagram
Light purple box 'Target Label' top-right with dotted arrow pointing left from diagram
Vertical dark red bar with white text 'Error Error Error' stacked vertically
Three light green boxes labeled 'Class 1', 'Class 2', 'Class m' stacked vertically to the right of the error bar
Equation box at bottom right showing error function E = 1/2 Σ(t_j - O_j)^2 with large red XXX

typography_notes: Sans-serif font throughout. Title is large bold dark text. Subtitle is blue. Diagram text is small black. Bottom annotation boxes use regular weight sans-serif. Equations use mathematical notation with subscripts. 'NOT' in the note box is emphasized.
animation_state: All elements appear fully visible; no mid-build animation indicated.
recreation_brief: 1. Set slide background to light gray (#f5f5f5). 2. Add title 'Neural Network Model' centered at top in large bold dark text. 3. Add subtitle '(Current Layer is Hidden Layer)' below title in blue. 4. Add slide number '14' in a yellow circle at top-right. 5. Draw a large beige rectangle (#e8e0d0) in the center for the network diagram. 6. Place 'Input Sample' purple box top-left outside the rectangle with a dotted arrow pointing into it. 7. Place 'Target Label' purple box top-right outside with dotted arrow pointing from diagram to it. 8. Inside the beige rectangle, draw columns of Σ nodes: left column white with red Σ, middle column green with Σ, right column orange with Σ. Include a column of white circles with blue Σ outlines between left and middle (Previous Layer). 9. Add f(σ) boxes between node columns. 10. Add Net_j, O_j, Net_k, O_k labels with small boxes between layers. 11. Draw red weighted arrows connecting nodes across layers with labels like w_ji, w_kj. 12. Add output labels 'Output 1', 'Output 2', 'Output m' at the right end of the diagram. 13. Add a vertical dark red bar on the right side of the beige rectangle with vertical white text 'Error Error Error'. 14. Add green boxes 'Class 1', 'Class 2', 'Class m' to the right of the error bar. 15. At bottom, add annotation boxes: 'For Layer "j"' left, equation box with Net_j and O_j formulas, 'Previous Layer (l)' with up arrow labeled i, 'Current Layer (You are here)' with up arrow labeled j, 'Next Layer (k)' with up arrow labeled k, 'Note: Layer "j" is NOT Output Layer' right, and error equation box E = 1/2 Σ(t_j - O_j)^2 with red XXX at bottom-right.
